test_title: PYST 10: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 10 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Food blogs are often authored by food aficionados, sometimes known as ‘foodies’.

B. The blogger can benefit from it if he or she uses it professionally.

C. Food blogging is food journalism that combines an interest in food, blog writing, and food photography.

D. The greater the popularity of a food blogger, the more options for him/her to monetise his/her work.
solution:
The correct answer is **"CABD"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sentence C should come first as it is the opening of the paragraph. 
 
• Sentence A is the second sentence as it states that food blogs are authored by food aficionados.
 
• Sentence B is the third sentence as it states the benefits of being a food blogger.
 
• Sentence D comes at the end as it states the popularity of the blogger, and also provides a conclusion of the paragraph.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The paragraph after the re-arrangement is as follows:
 
• Food blogging is food journalism that combines an interest in food, blog writing, and food photography. Food blogs are often authored by food aficionados, sometimes known as ‘foodies’. The blogger can benefit from it if he or she uses it professionally. The greater the popularity of a food blogger, the more options for him/her to monetize his/her work.
